text: Bram and Kit hold a sheet of roofing against the wind on the barn roof during a violent thunderstorm. The wooden sculpture captures the frantic moment of the storm tearing the roof off. Ana crafted the piece with a middling touch.

context.title: Wind Over the Barn

tale.summary: A thunderstorm tore the roof off the barn

context.event: The first group crashed in three escape pods onto open grassland: Ana, Bram and Dee crawled clear.

label: slight
line: Is the midday ration ready? We'll see if we can make it taste good.

text: I want him to acknowledge the difference in our living spaces.
label: slight
line: This workshop feels much more organized than the kitchen, um...

context.trigger: Cy has just walked into the workshop where you are working.

text: I need to know if they are going to stay or leave.
label: none
line: Enough. The ground is settled, settled now.

text: I worry about what he saw at the barricade.
label: kind

text: I hope this commitment doesn't ruin the next meal.

text: I want her to stop watching me like I'm some stray animal.
label: slight
line: Look. The grain spilled on the floor costs effort to clean up.

context.speaker: Bram

text: I hope she will eat something soon.
label: kind
line: You haven't eaten much since the funeral, Dee. Are you alright, friend?

context.trigger: Dee has not eaten since the funeral and you are sitting across from her.
context.speaker: Mara

text: Old Odo was a steady soul, always checking the straightness of the rows. We owe him a proper rest, friend.
Hale, he was steady. Steady enough.
I will always choose your side for our meals and all the quiet mornings after.
I will be yours through every harsh season, Cy.
